title: Identify body
description: The body of an identify Artifact (#5): the media type one identifier version read from the bytes of one Blob, whatever the Blob is named. The Artifact's subject_ref is blob:<blob>. Only what the bytes tell: a family such as text/plain where the bytes cannot tell more. A file name or a declared type narrows it for each Attachment, and that narrowing, with a name the bytes disagree with, is not stored here. It has no blocks. Open, as artifact/body.

blob.description: The Blob whose bytes were read.

identifier.description: The identifier and its version; a new version reads a Blob again into a new Artifact.

media_type.description: The media type the bytes show, application/octet-stream when they show none the identifier knows.
